text:
Situation: Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. An earlier shortage was first posted on 2022-10-28 and has since been resolved. Current stock at Corvale East is 294 bottles (19.2 days) of the 200 mg/5 mL 100 mL presentation. Corvale General holds 397 bottles (26 days) of amoxicillin 400 mg/5 mL and 425 bottles (27.3 days) of amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium 200 mg/5 mL.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the product is not listed on the shortage list today. The prior shortage posting began 2022-10-28. FDA inspection 1114915 at NuCare Pharmaceuticals Inc (FEI 3003294404) ended 2020-01-10 with a VAI classification, 1,022 days before the 2022 shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to NuCare on 2019-09-27. NuCare's last inspection was NAI on 2025-03-12. FDA inspection 1067059 at Asclemed USA Inc. (FEI 3001452204) ended 2018-09-27 with an OAI classification; its last inspection was NAI on 2025-03-05.

Our position: Supply is adequate across both campuses. No active shortage exists. We should secure a reliable long-term source to avoid future disruption.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (plants 2INAMOXU24N-E and 2INAMOXU12N in Jordan); requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Sandoz Inc. as a secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as a tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Do not pursue Chartwell RX, LLC or Devatis Inc. at this time because their labels name no identifiable plant for quality verification.
